command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== IDENTITY ==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '=== OMEGA FILES ==='; for p in $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/omega_organ_activity.py $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_777_runtime.py $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/voice_host_777_live_client.py $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/frank_terminal_777.py $HOME/.local/bin/frank-omega; do if test -f "$p"; then echo PRESENT:$p; stat -c '%n|%s|%y|%a' "$p"; sha256sum "$p"; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done; echo '=== VOICE UNIT ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p DropInPaths -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '=== CLIENT UNIT ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p DropInPaths -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '=== DROPINS ==='; for d in $HOME/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d $HOME/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service.d; do echo DIR:$d; ls -la "$d" 2>&1 || true; for f in "$d"/*.conf; do test -f "$f" || continue; echo FILE:$f; sed -n '1,100p' "$f"; done; done; echo '=== PROCESSES ==='; pgrep -a -f 'voice_777_runtime|voice_full_runtime|voice_host_777_live_client|voice_host_live_client|frank_terminal_777' || true; echo '=== ORGAN CACHE ==='; XDG=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}; test -f "$XDG/frankenstein/omega_organ_activity.json" && cat "$XDG/frankenstein/omega_organ_activity.json" || echo NO_ACTIVE_CACHE
